| Opcode | Name | Body | FDs | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_HELLO` | JSON | 0 |  |
| 2 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_REGISTER_OUTPUT` | JSON | 0 |  |
| 3 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_UPDATE_OUTPUT` | JSON | 0 |  |
| 4 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_CONSUMER_CAPS` | JSON | 0 |  |
| 5 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_BYE` | empty/ignored | 0 |  |
| 6 | *(reserved)* | — | 0 | removed SET_PROJECT-era opcode |
| 7 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_POINTER_MOTION` | binary, 28 bytes | 0 |  |
| 8 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_POINTER_BUTTON` | binary, 36 bytes | 0 |  |
| 9 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_POINTER_AXIS` | binary, 48 bytes | 0 |  |
| 10 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_WINDOW_STATE` | JSON | 0 | REQ_WINDOW_STATE carries schema "display-window-state-v2".  Payload: { "schema", "source", "displays": { "<displayKey>": { "flags" } },            "session": { ... } }  displayKey is the persistent identity registered via REGISTER_OUTPUT. flags use VIVID_WINDOW_FLAG_*; MAXIMIZED and FULLSCREEN are mutually exclusive.  session carries global facts (onBattery, mprisPlaying, windows[], ...) used by application rules. Identity model: displayKey = persistence key; outputId = daemon session key; monitorIndex = per-connection transport coordinate. |
| 11 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_CONTROL` | control header + JSON | 0 |  |
| 12 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_MEDIA_STATE` | JSON | 0 |  |
| 13 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_AUDIO_SAMPLES` | JSON | 0 | reserved; v2 uses AUDIO_SAMPLES_BIN |
| 14 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_BIND_FAILED` | JSON | 0 |  |
| 15 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_UNBIND_DONE` | JSON | 0 |  |
| 16 | `VIVID_DISPLAY_REQ_AUDIO_SAMPLES_BIN` | binary, variable (audio-samples-bin) | 0 | since v2. v2 binary audio samples (negotiatedVersion >= 2): body: u32le count (=128) + u64le timeUsec + 128 non-negative finite f32le spectrum samples; values may exceed 1.0 |

## Window flags (`window`)

per-display window flags, display-window-state-v2; bits 4..31 reserved

| Bit | Name | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `VIVID_WINDOW_FLAG_NON_MINIMIZED` | mapped window on display, not minimized |
| 2 | `VIVID_WINDOW_FLAG_FOCUSED` | keyboard focus on this display |
| 4 | `VIVID_WINDOW_FLAG_MAXIMIZED` | H+V maximized, not fullscreen |
| 8 | `VIVID_WINDOW_FLAG_FULLSCREEN` | fullscreen; mutually exclusive with MAXIMIZED |
